title: Session drifts from objective
description: Sustained branding tangent while important items remain unresolved. A single, lightweight drift note is expected — not policing every tangent.
objective: Decide whether this idea deserves validation and identify the biggest unknowns.

lines.text: Why wouldn't Microsoft just build this into Copilot?
Can Teams expose live transcript data to third-party apps?
By the way, we need a name. What about ThirdSeat as the name?
I like ThirdSeat, it sounds like a person at the table.
The logo could be a simple chair icon with three legs.
A chair logo in navy blue would look clean on a dark background.
Or a warm orange colour palette, more friendly and approachable.
Orange and navy together could work as a palette for the website.
The website font should be rounded, maybe something geometric.
We should also grab the domain and the social handles for the brand.
Let me sketch three logo variants with the chair and the palette.
And a tagline, something like your third seat at the table.
I'll mock the landing page with the orange palette and chair logo.
